exposure: Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) severity (simple, moderate complexity, great complexity)
cohort: A multicenter cohort of 217 pregnant women with congenital heart disease, with an average age at delivery of 31.4 years.
finding: Moderate or great complexity CHD, higher NYHA functional class, and multiparity were identified as important predictive factors for cardiovascular events in pregnant women with congenital heart disease.
